s: Hilkot qeriat shema ubirkoteha ubo y"a seipim: qeriat shema shacharit vearbit hi min hattora, shenneemar: "ubeshokbeka ubequmeka". Yesh omerim shepparasha rishona bilbad hi min hattora, umah shenneemar beparasha sheniyya "ubeshokbeka ubequmeka" — bedibre tora hakkatub medabber. Veyesh omerim sheggam parasha b' hi min hattora. Veyesh omerim sheppasuq rishon bilbad shehu "shema yisrael" hu min hattora, umah shenneemar "vedibbarta bam ku' ubeshokbeka ubequmeka" — hu musab al pasuq rishon bilbad. Abal parashat tzitzit shettiqqenuha mishshum zekirat yetziat mitzrayim — ledibre hakkol hi middibre soperim keshemmazkir yetziat mitzrayim bipne atzmo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"z (ubaal nepesh yachamir leatzmo beshel tora bekol mah shennogea lemaaseh bechilluqe sebarot ellu, kemo sheyyitbaer lepanenu):

(Zeman qeriat shema shel shacharit) min hattora hu mishsheala ammud hashshachar, sheaz miqtzat bene adam regilim laqum mimmittatam. Veap al pi shehem muatim, hare omrah tora "ubequmeka" leshon yachid, lomar sheholekin ap achar hammiut. Abal haqqore qodem laken — lo yatza yede chobato min hattora, sheap shemmiqtzat bene adam qamim gam ken qodem alot hashshachar — miqreh hu, veen holekin acharayv. Vachakamim asu harchaqa vegader, vetiqqenu shello yiqra lekattechilla ad shaa sheddarkan shel rob bene adam laqum mimmittatam, dehaynu sheyyair hayyom kol kak ad sheyyireh et chabero berichuq d' ammot veyakkirennu. Vehu sheragil immo qetzat, sheim ragil immo harbeh — yakkirennu apillu merachoq harbeh, veim eno ragil immo kelal — lo yakkirennu apillu beqarob, ella kemo aksanya sheragil labo leqetz ittim:

Venimshak zemannah ad sop g' shaot mealot hashshachar shehu techillat zemannah min hattora, lepi sheyyesh qetzat bene adam shergilim laqum mimmittatam besop g' shaot al hayyom, kegon bene melakim vekayyotze bahem. Veshaot ellu hem zemanniyyot, shekkol yom ben arok ben qatzar nechelaq ley"b shaot, venimtza leolam rebia hayyom hu zeman qeriat shema ben beyom arok ben beyom qatzar. Velaken tzarik lizzaher bimot hachorep lemaher liqro qeriat shema, meachar shehayyom qatzar urebia hayyom qatzar hu:

Umitzva min hammubchar shello liqrotah miyyad sheheir hayyom keshiur shennitbaer, ella kevatiqin shehayu mekavvenim liqrotah meat qodem hannetz hachamma kede sheyyesayyemu qeriat shema ubirkoteha dehaynu "gaal yisrael" im hanetz hachamma, sheaz hu zeman tepilla lekattechilla kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"t, veyitpalelu miyyad kede lismok geulla litpilla. Umi sheyyukal lekavven velaasot ken — sekaro merubbeh meod, umubtach lo shehu ben olam habba. (Umi sheeno yakol lekavven laasot ken — en lehaqdim liqrot qeriat shema ulehitpallel qodem hanetz hachamma ella achar hanetz hachamma, mippene shezzeman hattepilla lekattechilla hu achar hanetz hachamma, uzeman qeriat shema nimshak ad rebia hayyom lekattechilla, shehavvatiqin shehayu maqdimin liqrot qodem netz hachamma meat — lo hayu maqdimin mishshum chobat qeriat shema, ella kede lekavven lehitpallel bedimdume chamma dehaynu bitchillat yetziatah, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"t. Veyesh omerim sheggam mishshum chobat qeriat shema hayu maqdimin liqrotah qodem netz hachamma, lepi shellekattechilla yesh liqrotah beshaa shehu sheat qima lerob bene adam kemo shennitbaer, vead netz hachamma qamim rob bene adam, sheen yeshenim achar netz hachamma ella bene melakim vekayyotze bahem. Lepikak mi sheeno yakol lekavven laasot kevatiqin — i epshar lo lismok geulla litpilla lekattechilla, ella im ken yukal lekavven sheyyiqra lepachot parasha rishona qodem netz hachamma vadday, veyitpallel achar netz hachamma vadday ap al pi shello yitpallel bedimdume chamma. Veim gam zeh lo yukal lekavven — yiqra qeriat shema ubirkoteha qodem netz hachamma lekattechilla, veyitpallel achar hanetz hachamma velo yismok geulla litpilla. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Veap al pi ken nakon lachush lassebara haacharona veliqro lepachot parasha rishona qodem netz hachamma ap al pi sheadayin lo labash tzitzit utepillin, veachar netz hachamma yiqraenna kullah im birkoteha veyismok geulla litpilla):
Im lo qara otah qodem netz hachamma — yesh lo lehaqdim liqrotah bimhera kol mah sheyyukal, im yesh lo tzitzit utepillin (vetzibbur lehitpallel immahem velismok geulla litpilla):

Mi shehu anus, kegon shehaya mashkim latzet ladderek miyyad sheala ammud hashshachar limqom gedude chayya velistim, sheyyitztarek laleket bimhera velo yukal laamod al maqom echad kesheyyaggia zeman qeriat shema velo lekavven biqriatah apillu bepasuq rishon bilbad, o shebbene hashshayyara holekim bimhera velo yamtinu kelal badderek kesheyyaggia zeman qeriat shema she[uka]l laamod ulekavven — yakol liqrotah bebeto miyyad sheala ammud hashshachar veyismok geulla litpilla veyitpallel kemo sheyyitbaer besop siman p"t, lepi shebbimqom ones heemidu al dibre tora shemmishsheala ammud hashshachar zemannah hu. Veyesh mi sheomer shehu haddin kesheyyesh qeburat met bair, o mila, o yom araba shemmarbim betachanunim achar hattepilla, utzerikim lemaher lehitpallel — yekolim liqrot qeriat shema mishsheala ammud hashshachar. Mikkol maqom, en lehaqdim lomar "yotzer or" kol kak bahashkama, ad sheyyakkir al kol panim ben tekelet lelaban:

Abal mi shemmashkim latzet badderek shello bimqom gedude chayya velistim, vegam en bene hashshayyara nechpazim kol kak badderek beinyan sheyyukal laamod ulekavven apillu bepasuq rishon bilbad kesheyyaggia zeman qeriat shema — lo yiqra bebeto ap al pi sheala ammud hashshachar, ella badderek kesheyyaggia zeman qeriat shema (veheak yinhag im hattepilla — yitbaer besop siman p"t):

Im qeraah miyyad sheala ammud hashshachar, ap al pi shello haya anus — yatza, shebbediabad heemiduhu al dibre tora bekol inyan. Veim qara belo birkoteha — yachazor liqrotah bizmannah bebirkoteha, sheap shekkebar yatza yede chobat qeriat shema — lo hipsid birkoteha, kemo shennitbaer besiman s':

Mi shehaya anus velo qara qeriat shema arbit ballayla, shehu qoreah achar sheala ammud hashshachar kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"h, vehu mashkim gam ken latzet ladderek limqom gedude chayya velistim beinyan sheyyukal liqro qeriat shema shel shacharit miyyad sheala ammud hashshachar — i epshar liqro qeriat shema b' peamim, achat bishbil layla veachat bishbil yom, shemmeachar sheasa leotah shaa layla — i epshar lachazor velaasotah yom, ella yiqra bishbil qeriat shema shel layla shezzemannah ober, sheachar netz hachamma i epshar liqrotah kelal kemo sheyyitbaer sham, veshel shacharit yamtin ulay yizdammen lo liqrotah bizmannah kehilkatah:

Ap al pi shezzemannah nimshak ad sop shaa g', im obra shaa g' velo qeraah — qoreah bebirkoteha kol shaa d' shehu shelish hayyom, kedin tepillat hashshachar shehi ad shelish hayyom. Veen lo sakar al qeriatah ella keqore battora, abal lo kemi sheqqoreah bizmannah, sheaz sekaro gadol mehaoseq battora kol hayyom apillu shello bishat qeriat shema utepilla. Veim obra shaa d' velo qeraah — shub eno yakol liqrotah im birkoteha. Abal belo birkoteha yakol liqrotah kol hayyom. Vetob sheyyiqraenna kede leqabbel alayv ol malkut shamayim (veyesh omerim sheyakol liqrotah kol hayyom bebirkoteha. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona):

Im lo qeraah bayyom, yesh omerim sheyyesh lah tashlumin bearbit, sheyyiqra techilla shel arbit veachar kak shel shacharit. Veken im lo qara qeriat shema shel arbit yesh lah tashlumin beshacharit, kemo bitpilla sheim lo hitpallel arbit mitpallel shacharit shettayim. Veyesh omerim sheenah doma litpilla shehi baqqashat rachamim veyakol lebaqqesh bekol et ubekol shaa, abal qeriat shema tala hakkatub zo bizman shekiba vezo bizman qima, veek yiqra shel shekiba bizman qima o shel qima bizman shekiba, veal zeh neemar: "meuvvat lo yukal litqon" ku' (veken iqqar). Vekol zeh biqriat shema bilbaddah, abal birkoteha — ledibre hakkol i epshar leomran ella bizmannan (ki heak yomar "yotzer or" baereb va"asher bidbaro maarib arabim" babboqer, uberakot haacharonot hen semukot larishonot):
